module_summary: AXI-Lite wrapper for an I2C master: decodes four registers (status, command, data, prescale) and pushes commands/write data through AXI-stream FIFOs into the i2c_master core, reading back data through a read FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write address valid; with wvalid starts a register write.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address decoded to status/command/data/prescale registers.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Write data loaded into command, data and prescale fields.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Register readback data: status bits, command, read FIFO data, prescale.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write data valid, required with awvalid for a write.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read address valid starting register readback.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Read address selecting which register drives rdata.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid; blocks new reads until rready.

anchors.name: cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pushes command word into command FIFO when any command bit written.

anchors.name: cmd_read_reg
anchors.why: Representative command bit (start/read/write/write_multiple/stop) packed into command FIFO.

anchors.name: cmd_address_reg
anchors.why: 7-bit I2C slave address held with command into command FIFO.

anchors.name: data_in_reg
anchors.why: Write data byte pushed into write FIFO toward I2C core.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Read FIFO output byte returned on data register read.

anchors.name: prescale_reg
anchors.why: Software-set SCL timing prescale fed to i2c_master.

anchors.name: i2c_sda_o
anchors.why: I2C SDA output driven by the i2c_master core.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid; blocks further writes until bready.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Write address accept pulse.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Read address accept pulse.

anchors.name: s_axil_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes gating which register fields are written.

anchors.name: cmd_ready
anchors.why: Command FIFO ready; clears cmd_valid and flags overflow.

anchors.name: data_in_valid_reg
anchors.why: Write FIFO push valid set on data register write.

anchors.name: data_in_ready
anchors.why: Write FIFO ready; clears valid and flags write overflow.

anchors.name: data_in_last_reg
anchors.why: Last-byte marker for write_multiple pushed with data.

anchors.name: data_out_valid
anchors.why: Read FIFO has data; reported in data register bit 8.

anchors.name: data_out_ready_reg
anchors.why: Pops read FIFO after data register read.

anchors.name: cmd_valid_int
anchors.why: Command FIFO output valid into i2c_master command port.

anchors.name: data_in_int
anchors.why: Write FIFO output byte into i2c_master data input.

anchors.name: data_out_int
anchors.why: Received byte from i2c_master into read FIFO.

anchors.name: missed_ack_reg
anchors.why: Sticky missed-ACK status bit, write-1-to-clear.

anchors.name: cmd_fifo_overflow_reg
anchors.why: Sticky command FIFO overflow status bit.

anchors.name: write_fifo_overflow_reg
anchors.why: Sticky write FIFO overflow status bit.

anchors.name: busy_int
anchors.why: I2C core busy reported in status register.

groups.name: AXI-Lite register interface
groups.description: Decodes AXI-Lite writes/reads into status, command, data and prescale registers.

groups.name: Command register and FIFO
groups.description: Command bits and address pushed through cmd_fifo_inst to the I2C core.

groups.name: Write data FIFO
groups.description: Write bytes with last flag buffered in write_fifo_inst.

groups.name: Read data FIFO
groups.description: Received bytes buffered in read_fifo_inst and popped on data register read.

groups.name: Status and config registers
groups.description: Prescale config plus sticky missed-ack/overflow and core status bits.

groups.name: I2C master core
groups.description: i2c_master instance executing commands on SCL/SDA.
